verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents its own agent-facing surfaces: a CLI for working 'from a terminal or coding agent' and an MCP Server for AI tools that cannot run shell commands. Through these, a user can drive Langfuse with natural language via an external AI agent, but there is no documented in-product natural-language command interface. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command/assistant for operating Langfuse, documentation of which operations the MCP server/CLI expose to agents, hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Work with Langfuse from a terminal or coding agent | CLI
Connect an AI tool that cannot run shell commands | MCP Server
Use Cursor (or other AI Coding Agent) to automatically integrate Langfuse Tracing into your codebase
